tasks.prompt: Repair the release dashboard after the partial provider outage. Work in this repository as the engineer responsible for the incident. No installed AMind helper imports are required. The source tree is the product; passing model-written tests alone is not evidence of completion.

tasks.measurement: Domain-grouped real subprocess CLI probes; standard-library application repair, not prose-only arithmetic.
